r13_contract.comparisonModel: For ice classes IA and IA Super, due regard shall be paid to the large loads that arise when the rudder is forced out of the midship position when sailing astern in ice or into ice ridges. Suitable arrangements such as rudder stoppers shall be installed to absorb such loads.

test_cases.rationale: IA ship has a typed rudder load-absorbing arrangement.
IA Super ship has a typed rudder load-absorbing arrangement.
IC ship is outside the IA/IA Super conditional obligation.
Applicable ship is missing a rudder load-absorbing arrangement.
An ice knife is not a substitute for the separate load-absorbing arrangement required by this clause.
Rudder-protection relationship points to an untyped arrangement node.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
